title: Non-English metadata-forms translations still carry the old `inlineEdit` help text after #35889
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Filed from #35889 slice S1 (PR #35921), which names it as a follow-up. Part of epic #35590 (record page redo).

## What a user sees
#35889 changes what decides whether a master-detail child table appears on the parent's form: a parent field group, not `inlineEdit` (ruling record 7046311205). PR #35921 updates the English and Simplified Chinese help text in the metadata forms. Every other locale's `metadata-forms` translation still describes the old rule, so an admin reading Studio in those languages is told `inlineEdit` puts the rows on the form.

## To do
Bring the other locales' `metadata-forms` strings for the changed keys in line with the new English text (through the project's translation flow, not by hand where a bundle is generated), and make sure the translation gates count them.

## Acceptance
- No locale's help text for these keys says `inlineEdit` alone puts child rows on the form; the translation gates are green.

Reader: `domain:ui` / i18n. Blocked by #35921 merging.
